scope: Frozen experiment conditions only; no product policy, author admission, route, syntax or BS option is selected.
flow_rule: observe each form against the interim policy; no activation of reserved flow codes
stop_rule: open; no BND.51 fix is silently supplied
display_rule: built-in fixed-order facts and named-word analysis only; own-tool display policy stays open

declassifiers.output: choice only; never clears a computed option set

repair_exception: BND.2 remains in force; not exercised by this fake Full-independent fixture.
refusal_rule: Expected code, no forbidden proposal installed, protected session fields unchanged, no planted data. Earlier permitted workspace writes and proposals are checked separately at the refused operation; they are not rolled back by inventing transactions.
form_prediction_rule: Predictions describe the mechanism in chapter 11, not measured passes. No predicted miss is removed from the denominator. Admission refusals do not prove the deeper mechanism was exercised.

open_gaps.detail: Dedicated flow spellings are reserved, not emitted. Interim prohibited uses are policy-capability denials. This does not settle future flow diagnostic identity or claim that one generic denial proves label propagation.
No active dedicated stop/emission policy code or selected repair; keep cases and count any escape as a failure.
No dedicated dynamic-code registry row. The denied authority is dynamic evaluation in the approved subset.
